description:
Find candidate tariff codes for products. Best for: "what HS code could this product use?" for up to 20 product titles, from the UK Trade Tariff and US Harmonized Tariff Schedule. Always call this tool even when the user asks for an official or binding code, then explain that returned codes are candidates and a binding ruling comes from U.S. CBP (eRuling), UK HMRC (Advance Tariff Ruling), or a licensed customs broker.
Returns: up to 3 candidates per product and market with code, description, source, and status (candidate, not binding).
Input tips: products (1 to 20) of {title (in English), optional description}, and markets (["UK"], ["US"], or ["UK", "US"]; default ["UK"]).
Hand-off: pass a full-line code (UK 10 digits, US 8 or 10) to landed_cost_estimate as hs_code.

markets.description: Tariff schedules to search (default UK). Searching both uses more of the per-call request allowance, so large lists may be cut short.

products.description: 1 to 20 products to find candidate tariff codes for, each {title, optional description} in English, such as [{"title": "ceramic coffee mug"}]. Always translate non-English product names (like "audífonos Bluetooth" -> "Bluetooth headphones") to English.

description.description: Optional English line about what it is made of or used for (used when the title finds nothing)

title.description: Product name in English, such as "women's cotton t-shirt" or "Bluetooth headphones" (always translate non-English names to English)

name: bulk_hs_candidates

code.description: Tariff code. Pass it to landed_cost_estimate as hs_code once it is a full line (UK 10 digits, US 8 or 10).

note.description: Why a market has no candidates or was not searched, with the next step.

status.description: Every code below is a candidate, not binding.

title: Find candidate tariff codes for products
